implemented_features: GoalComposer component with required outcome textarea, optional context/constraints, and client-side validation (50KB conservative client cap)
Submission state machine: idle → validating → submitting → acknowledged(missionId) / rejected(error) / uncertain(network failure). NEVER shows success before gateway returns 202 with missionId.
Client-generated UUID idempotencyKey per submission; preserved across retries. Same key → same missionId on the gateway side (verified by E2E-3).

Network-failure UNCERTAIN state: shows 'Action submitted; final result not yet confirmed. The gateway may have received the goal, but the acknowledgement was lost.' with explicit Retry button (uses the same idempotencyKey). No blind retry.

Negative control: gateway down disables the Submit button AND shows an inline 'Gateway is unreachable. The submit button is disabled — no submission can be made until the gateway is back online.' notice. No phantom mission.
Server-canonical mission ID capture: only stored in lastSubmittedMissionId AFTER the 202 response is parsed. Auto-navigates to Mission Control with the actual missionId.

MissionList component showing browser-known missions only (no server list endpoint exists — honest notice). Each entry shows status badge (NON-color-only cues: icon + label), last-observed time, source (submit/lookup), truncated missionId.

MissionLookup component for known-ID lookup via GET /v1/missions/{id}. Maps 404 → 'not found or not owned by this caller (intentional ambiguity)'. Maps 429 → 'rate limit reached'. Maps 401 → 'session may have expired'.
WorkSection grid layout: Goal Composer (3fr) + MissionList + MissionLookup (2fr) on lg+; stacked on smaller viewports.
Cookie-included fetch (credentials: 'include') so BFF cookie is auto-sent on every /api/genesis/* call.
Controlled-test banner still permanent. Evidence tier labels not yet per-artifact (deferred to G7-04).

8 E2E tests in scripts/g7-02-e2e-submission.ts covering the full happy path: BFF cookie setup, /health 200, dev-mode limitations detected, POST /v1/missions 202 with missionId, idempotent re-submit returns same missionId, GET /v1/missions/{id} 200 with terminal snapshot, GET /v1/missions/{id}/artifacts 200 with verified output.md, and negative control (gateway SIGKILL → 503 UNAVAILABLE).

open_findings.description: GoalComposer auto-navigates to Mission Control 600ms after acknowledgement. This is intentional UX (let the user see the ack briefly), but it means a fast refresh within that window could lose the breadcrumb state. The missionId IS preserved in the Zustand store and re-pollable via MissionBreadcrumb, so no actual loss.
open_findings.action: No fix needed for G7-02; revisit if user feedback indicates the delay is jarring.

open_findings.description: The MissionLookup allows arbitrary text input. The gateway expects a UUID missionId; non-UUID strings will return 404 (MISSION_NOT_FOUND). The UI maps this to 'not found or not owned' honestly — no client-side UUID format validation is enforced, to avoid masking gateway-side errors.

Sandbox limitation: background gateway processes are killed when the parent bash call returns. The connected-state screenshot shows 'Disconnected' because the gateway process died between starting it and capturing the screenshot. The E2E test (which keeps the gateway alive in-process) verifies the full happy path; the screenshot is from the honest disconnected state.
open_findings.action: No fix needed. Use the E2E test output as proof of the happy path.

known_limitations: Browser auth requires the BFF cookie (G7-01 closure). The GoalComposer uses credentials:'include' on every fetch so the cookie is auto-sent.

IdempotencyKey is in-memory only on the gateway side; does not survive gateway restart. If the user retries after a restart, the gateway may create new work (different missionId) — this is documented gateway behavior.
GoalComposer disables Submit when connectionState is 'disconnected' or 'failed'. If the gateway comes back online, ConnectionStatus's 15s poll will update the state and re-enable Submit.
MissionList is browser-local only (no gateway list endpoint). If the user clears browser storage or uses a different browser, the list is empty — no server-side recovery.
MissionLookup returns 404 for both 'not found' and 'not owned' (intentional gateway ambiguity). The UI honestly states both possibilities.
Cost (usd) in MissionCost is typically $0 in dev mode — shown as 'Not measured' in G7-06 Insights.
Controlled environment: GENESIS_EXECUTION_MODE=development uses MemoryComputer + DEVELOPMENT_REASONING_FALLBACK. The banner is permanent. Real ZAI/OpenBot integration is NOT claimed.
